This code includes analysis of chemical, use, emission, media occurrence, and intake data, and generation of figures supporting the manuscript: Isaacs, KK, Wambaugh JF, Charest N, Sinclair G, Shapiro AJ, Whitehead H, Boatman A, Ferland TM, Wall JT, Wilson M, Sams RL, Edwards S, Thomas RS, and Paul Friedman K. Characterizing Exposure Pathways for a Global Collection of Chemicals. Submitted to Environmental Science and Technology.

Code: Kristin Isaacs, 10/2026

```{r}
source("ROCKSsetup.R")


preview_png <- function(
  png_file,
  scale = 0.25,
  suffix = "_preview"
) {

  stopifnot(file.exists(png_file))

  info <- png::readPNG(png_file, info = TRUE)
  dims <- attr(info, "dim")

  new_width  <- max(1, round(dims[2] * scale))
  new_height <- max(1, round(dims[1] * scale))

  # Unique preview filename based on original filename
  base <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(png_file))

  preview_file <- file.path(
    tempdir(),
    paste0(base, suffix, ".png")
  )

  magick::image_read(png_file) |>
    magick::image_resize(
      paste0(new_width, "x", new_height)
    ) |>
    magick::image_write(preview_file)

  preview_file
}

#Functions for estimating density

#------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper: interpolate KDE density back to original points
#------------------------------------------------------------

interp_kde2d <- function(x0, y0, kde) {
  
  gx <- kde$x
  gy <- kde$y
  gz <- kde$z
  
  out <- rep(NA_real_, length(x0))
  
  inside <- x0 >= min(gx) &
    x0 <= max(gx) &
    y0 >= min(gy) &
    y0 <= max(gy) &
    is.finite(x0) &
    is.finite(y0)
  
  x0i <- x0[inside]
  y0i <- y0[inside]
  
  ix <- findInterval(x0i, gx, all.inside = TRUE)
  iy <- findInterval(y0i, gy, all.inside = TRUE)
  
  ix[ix == length(gx)] <- length(gx) - 1
  iy[iy == length(gy)] <- length(gy) - 1
  
  x1 <- gx[ix]
  x2 <- gx[ix + 1]
  y1 <- gy[iy]
  y2 <- gy[iy + 1]
  
  z11 <- gz[cbind(ix, iy)]
  z21 <- gz[cbind(ix + 1, iy)]
  z12 <- gz[cbind(ix, iy + 1)]
  z22 <- gz[cbind(ix + 1, iy + 1)]
  
  wx <- (x0i - x1) / (x2 - x1)
  wy <- (y0i - y1) / (y2 - y1)
  
  zi <- (1 - wx) * (1 - wy) * z11 +
    wx * (1 - wy) * z21 +
    (1 - wx) * wy * z12 +
    wx * wy * z22
  
  out[inside] <- zi
  
  out
}

estimate_point_density <- function(
    df,
    flag_col,
    n = 300,
    xvar = "x",
    yvar = "y"
) {

  if (!all(c(xvar, yvar, flag_col) %in% names(df))) {
    stop("df must contain columns x, y, and the flag_col column.")
  }

  df$x <- df[[xvar]]
  df$y <- df[[yvar]]
    
  df_flagged <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data[[flag_col]] == 1) %>%
    dplyr::filter(is.finite(x), is.finite(y))
  
  if (nrow(df_flagged) < 2) {
    stop("Need at least 2 finite x/y points where flag_col == 1.")
  }
  
kde <- MASS::kde2d(
x = df_flagged$x,
y = df_flagged$y,
n = n
)
  
  density_grid <- expand.grid(
    x = kde$x,
    y = kde$y
  )
  
  density_grid$density <- as.vector(kde$z)
  
  point_density <- df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      density = interp_kde2d(x, y, kde)
    )
  
  list(
    point_density = point_density[, c("x", "y", "density",flag_col)],
    density_grid = density_grid,
    kde = kde,
    flag_col = flag_col
  )
}

estimate_density_contours <- function(
    density_result,
    density_quantiles = c(0.50, 0.75, 0.90)
) {
  
  if (any(!is.finite(density_quantiles)) ||
      any(density_quantiles < 0 | density_quantiles > 1)) {
    stop("density_quantiles must be numeric values between 0 and 1.")
  }
  
  density_quantiles <- sort(unique(density_quantiles))
  
  point_density <- density_result$point_density
  kde <- density_result$kde
  flag_col <- density_result$flag_col
  
  density_thresholds <- stats::quantile(
    point_density$density[point_density[[flag_col]] == 1],
    probs = density_quantiles,
    na.rm = TRUE,
    names = FALSE
  )
  
  threshold_df <- data.frame(
    density_quantile = density_quantiles,
    density_threshold = density_thresholds,
    density_quantile_label = paste0(round(100 * density_quantiles), "th percentile")
  )
  
  contour_df <- do.call(
    rbind,
    lapply(seq_along(density_quantiles), function(i) {
      
      qi <- density_quantiles[i]
      ti <- density_thresholds[i]
      qlab <- paste0(round(100 * qi), "th percentile")
      
      these_contours <- grDevices::contourLines(
        x = kde$x,
        y = kde$y,
        z = kde$z,
        levels = ti
      )
      
      if (length(these_contours) == 0) {
        return(NULL)
      }
      
      do.call(
        rbind,
        lapply(seq_along(these_contours), function(j) {
          data.frame(
            x = these_contours[[j]]$x,
            y = these_contours[[j]]$y,
            density_quantile = qi,
            density_threshold = ti,
            density_quantile_label = qlab,
            contour_piece = j,
            contour_id = paste0("q", round(100 * qi), "_piece", j)
          )
        })
      )
    })
  )
  
  if (is.null(contour_df)) {
    contour_df <- data.frame(
      x = numeric(),
      y = numeric(),
      density_quantile = numeric(),
      density_threshold = numeric(),
      density_quantile_label = character(),
      contour_piece = integer(),
      contour_id = character()
    )
  }
  
  list(
    contours = contour_df,
    density_thresholds = threshold_df
  )
}


estimate_coverage_contours <- function(
    density_result,
    coverages = c(0.50, 0.75, 0.90)
) {

  point_density <- density_result$point_density
  kde <- density_result$kde
  flag_col <- density_result$flag_col

  if (!flag_col %in% names(point_density)) {
    stop("flag column not found in point_density")
  }

  flagged_density <- point_density$density[
    point_density[[flag_col]] == 1 &
      is.finite(point_density$density)
  ]

  if (length(flagged_density) == 0) {
    stop("No finite densities found for flagged points")
  }

  # density threshold that leaves X% of points inside
  density_thresholds <- quantile(
    flagged_density,
    probs = 1 - coverages,
    na.rm = TRUE,
    names = FALSE
  )

  threshold_df <- data.frame(
    coverage = coverages,
    density_threshold = density_thresholds
  )

  contour_df <- do.call(
    rbind,
    lapply(seq_along(coverages), function(i) {

      cov <- coverages[i]
      thr <- density_thresholds[i]

      cl <- grDevices::contourLines(
        x = kde$x,
        y = kde$y,
        z = kde$z,
        levels = thr
      )

      if (length(cl) == 0) {
        return(NULL)
      }

      do.call(
        rbind,
        lapply(seq_along(cl), function(j) {

          data.frame(
            x = cl[[j]]$x,
            y = cl[[j]]$y,
            coverage = cov,
            density_threshold = thr,
            contour_piece = j,
            contour_id = paste0("cov_", cov, "_", j)
          )

        })
      )
    })
  )

  list(
    contours = contour_df,
    thresholds = threshold_df
  )
}
```

Sector and Sector Class Densities

```{r}

#create Density Maps for each sector
tmp<-left_join(inventory_all_descriptors2, fingerprints, by=c("cichem_id"="cichem"))
tmp<-left_join(tmp, rocks_sector_table, by=c("cichem_id"="cichem_id"))
sector_densities<-tmp[,c("densmap_1","densmap_2","sector_class","consumer","food","industrial","agricultural","pharmaceutical")]
sector_densities$pharma_only <- ifelse(sector_densities$sector_class == "Pharmaceutical Only", 1, 0)
sector_densities$industrial_only <- ifelse(sector_densities$sector_class == "Industrial Only", 1, 0)
sector_densities$unknown <- ifelse(sector_densities$sector_class == "Unknown", 1, 0)
sector_densities$food_only <- ifelse(sector_densities$sector_class == "Food Only", 1, 0)
sector_densities$multiple <- ifelse(sector_densities$sector_class == "Multiple Inventories", 1, 0)
sector_densities$ag_only <- ifelse(sector_densities$sector_class == "Agricultural Only", 1, 0)
sector_densities$consumer_only <- ifelse(sector_densities$sector_class == "Consumer Only", 1, 0)


#loop over sector classes, estimate densities, and store as named list
flag_cols <- c(
  "pharma_only",
  "industrial_only",
  "unknown",
  "food_only",
  "multiple",
  "ag_only",
  "consumer_only",
  "consumer",
  "food",
  "pharmaceutical",
  "industrial",
  "agricultural"
)

for (flag_col in flag_cols) {
  density_result <- estimate_point_density(
    df = sector_densities,
    flag_col = flag_col,
    xvar = "densmap_1",
    yvar = "densmap_2"
  )
  
  assign(paste0("dens_", gsub(" ", "_", tolower(flag_col))), density_result)
}
```

Sector Plot: Figure S1

```{r}
#============================================================================================================================================
do_sector_plot = function() {

k<-data.frame(cbind(as.logical(rocks_sector_table$consumer),as.logical(rocks_sector_table$food),as.logical(rocks_sector_table$industrial),as.logical(rocks_sector_table$agricultural),as.logical(rocks_sector_table$pharmaceutical)))
colnames(k)<-c("Consumer","Food","Industrial","Agricultural","Pharmaceutical")
#upset(k, intersect=c("Consumer","Food","Industrial","Agricultural","Pharmaceutical"))

sum<-rowSums(k)

k$Unknown<-FALSE
k$Unknown[which(sum==0)]<-TRUE

p <- upset(
 # k[sum > 0, ],
  k,
  intersect = c("Consumer", "Food", "Industrial", "Agricultural", "Pharmaceutical", "Unknown"),
  max_degree = 3,
  min_size = 200,
  sort_intersections_by = "cardinality",
  width_ratio = 0.3,
  
  base_annotations = list(
    "Intersection size" = intersection_size(
      counts = TRUE,
      bar_number_threshold = Inf,   # <- prevents labels being moved inside bars
      text = list(colour = "black",
                  size=3
      ),
      mapping = aes(fill = "All")
    ) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("All" = ULcolors[4]), guide = "none") +
      ylab("Intersection size")+labs(title = "Overlap Across Sectors") +
      theme(axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14,vjust=-10))
  ),
  
  set_sizes = upset_set_size(
    mapping = aes(fill = "All")
  ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("All" = ULcolors[3]), guide = "none") +
    theme(
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_blank()
    ),
  matrix = intersection_matrix() +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme(
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_blank()
    )
) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12)
  )

return(p)
}

)
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 5

do_inventory_plot = function() {
#Generate the Inventory Plot

  
#Decide which categories to keep
j<-data.frame(table(inventory_all_descriptors2$most_common_function_category))


base<-inventory_all_descriptors2
keepfunctions<-c("Fragrance","Flavouring and nutrient","Softener and conditioner","Dye","Biocide","Surfactant (surface active agent)","Solvent","Emulsifier","Pharmaceutical","Pigment","Unknown")

base$most_common_function_category<-capitalize_first(base$most_common_function_category)

base$most_common_function_category[which(is.na(base$most_common_function_category))]<-"Unknown"
base$most_common_function_category[which(base$most_common_function_category=="NANA")]<-"Unknown"

base$most_common_function_category[which(!base$most_common_function_category %in% keepfunctions)]<-"Other"

j<-data.frame(table(base$superclass))
keepclasses<-c("Benzenoids","Organoheterocyclic compounds","Organic acids and derivatives","Lipids and lipid-like molecules","Organic oxygen compounds","Mixed metal/non-metal compounds","Organic nitrogen compounds","Phenylpropanoids and polyketides","Organohalogen compounds","Organometallic compounds","UVCB", "unknown")
base$superclass[which(!base$superclass %in% keepclasses)]<-"Other"

#  Long format
# ----------------------------
long_dt <- data.table::melt(
  data.table(base),
  id.vars = "inventory_type",
  measure.vars = c("most_common_function_category", "sector_class", "kingdom", "superclass"),
  variable.name = "category_type",
  value.name = "category_value"
)

#remove things we don't want to plot
long_dt<-long_dt[which(!(category_value=="Unknown" & category_type %in% c("most_common_function_category"))),]
long_dt<-long_dt[which(!(category_value=="UVCB" & category_type %in% c("superclass"))),]


# Explicit Missing
invisible({
  long_dt[is.na(category_value), category_value := "Missing"]
  long_dt[is.na(inventory_type), inventory_type := "Missing"]
})

# ----------------------------
# 4. Plot function (fully fixed)
# ----------------------------
make_plot <- function(varname,
                      base_colors,
                      title = NULL,
                      show_y = TRUE,
                      show_x = TRUE, type="inventory") {
  
  sub_dt <- copy(long_dt[category_type == varname])
  
  # Order categories globally (Missing first ⇒ plotted on top)
  freq <- sub_dt[, .N, by = category_value][order(N)]
  if ("Missing" %in% freq$category_value) {
    levels_order <- c("Missing", setdiff(freq$category_value, "Missing"))
  } else {
    levels_order <- freq$category_value
  }
  sub_dt[, category_value := factor(category_value, levels = levels_order)]
  
  # Build safe color vector
  cats <- levels(sub_dt$category_value)
  col_vec <- rep(base_colors, length.out = length(cats))
  names(col_vec) <- cats
  col_vec["Missing"] <- "#B0B0B0"
  
  p <- ggplot(sub_dt, aes(x = inventory_type, fill = category_value)) +
    geom_bar(position = "fill") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = col_vec, drop = FALSE) +
    labs(
      title = ifelse(is.null(title), varname, title),
      x = if (show_x) "Sector Category" else NULL,
      y = if (show_y) "Proportion" else NULL,
      fill = varname
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
      legend.key.size = unit(0.35, "cm")
    )
  
  # Remove axes if requested
  if (!show_y) {
    p <- p + theme(
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
    )
  }
  
  if (!show_x) {
    p <- p + theme(
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
    )
  }
  
  return(p)
}

#By Sector

tmp <- base
tmp$inventory_type <- tmp$sector_class

long_dt <- data.table::melt(
  data.table(tmp),
  id.vars = "inventory_type",
  measure.vars = c("most_common_function_category", "kingdom", "superclass"),
  variable.name = "category_type",
  value.name = "category_value"
)

# remove things we don't want to plot
long_dt <- long_dt[
  !(category_value == "Unknown" & category_type == "most_common_function_category")
]
long_dt <- long_dt[
  !(category_value == "UVCB" & category_type == "superclass")
]

# Explicit Missing
invisible({
  long_dt[is.na(category_value), category_value := "Missing"]
  long_dt[is.na(inventory_type), inventory_type := "Missing"]
})

# force common x order across all panels
sector_order <- unique(long_dt$inventory_type)
sector_order<-  c("Multiple Inventories","Industrial Only","Consumer Only","Pharmaceutical Only","Agricultural Only","Food Only","Unknown")
long_dt[, inventory_type := factor(inventory_type, levels = sector_order)]

# counts per sector_class for aligned bar panel
count_dt <- as.data.table(base)
count_dt[is.na(sector_class), sector_class := "Missing"]
count_dt <- count_dt[, .(n_chemicals = .N), by = sector_class]
count_dt[, sector_class := factor(sector_class, levels = sector_order)]

# horizontal panel with bars aligned to same x positions

library(scales)

p2 <- ggplot(count_dt, aes(x = sector_class, y = n_chemicals)) +
  geom_col(fill = "grey40", width = 0.8) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = sector_order, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = label_comma()) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Number of chemicals",
    title = "Number of Chemicals"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    plot.background = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_blank()
  )
kingdomcols<-c(inorgcolor,strucunknown,unstructcolor,orgcolor)
p1 <- make_plot("most_common_function_category", ULcolors, show_x = TRUE, title = "Most Common Function")
p3 <- make_plot("kingdom", kingdomcols, show_x = FALSE, title = "Structural Kingdom")
p4 <- make_plot("superclass", ULcolors[9:19], show_x = FALSE, title = "Structural Superclass")

final_plot <-  p2/p3 / p4 /  p1 

return(final_plot)
}
```

```{r}
do_sector_mapping<- function() {
j<-fingerprints

#merge
tmp<-left_join(inventory_all_descriptors2, j, by=c("cichem_id"="cichem"))

tmp<-tmp[which(!is.na(tmp$densmap_1)),] #structurable

#make a ggplot scatter of tnse1 vs tsne2 colored by sector class
set.seed(125)
colors<-sample(ULcolors, length(unique(tmp$sector_class)), replace = FALSE)
library(ggplot2)
#order the levels of sector

tmp$sector_class[tmp$sector_class=="Multiple Inventories"]<-"Multiple Sectors" 
tmp$sector_class <- factor(tmp$sector_class, levels = c("Industrial Only","Consumer Only","Multiple Sectors","Unknown","Pharmaceutical Only","Agricultural Only" ,"Food Only" ))

colors<-c("Industrial Only"= ind_color,"Consumer Only"= consumer_color,"Multiple Sectors"= multiple_color,"Unknown"= unknown_color,"Pharmaceutical Only"=pharma_color,"Agricultural Only" = ag_color,  
"Food Only" = food_color)

# count points per sector
group_sizes <- table(tmp$sector_class)

# add size to data
```

```{r}

do_uselandscape_plot = function() {
  # Load necessary libraries
  library(ComplexHeatmap)
  library(grid)
  library(circlize)
  library(dplyr)
  library(data.table)


#==================================================
# LOAD DATA
#==================================================

#load latest version of inventory_use data_DATE

file<-list.files("Data", pattern = "inventory_use_data.*\\.RData$", full.names = TRUE)
file <- file[order(file.info(file)$mtime, decreasing = TRUE)][1]  # Get the most recent file
load(file)

inventory_use$kingdom[which(inventory_use$kingdom=="UVCB")]<-"Unstructurable"
tmp<-inventory_use[which(inventory_use$kingdom != c("Unknown")),]

file<-list.files("Data", pattern = "inventory_emission_data.*\\.RData$", full.names = TRUE)
file <- file[order(file.info(file)$mtime, decreasing = TRUE)][1]  # Get the most recent file
load(file)

usedata<-left_join(tmp, inventory_emission)

usedata<-usedata[,c("inventory_production","inventory_emission","predicted_emission","inventory_industry","inventory_product","consumer_ciexpo","lp_ciexpo","predicted_function_ciexpo","reported_function_ciexpo")]



#==================================================
# PREP MATRICES
#==================================================

flag_mat <- as.matrix(usedata)
storage.mode(flag_mat) <- "numeric"

# grouping factor for all combinations
grp <- interaction(
  tmp$sector_class,
  tmp$kingdom,
  drop = TRUE,
  lex.order = TRUE
)

# counts of 1s by group and variable
count_mat <- rowsum(flag_mat, grp, na.rm = TRUE)
count_mat <- as.matrix(count_mat)

# counts across all chemicals for each original variable
count_chems <- colSums(flag_mat, na.rm = TRUE)

# number of chemicals in each group
group_n <- as.vector(table(grp)[rownames(count_mat)])

# proportion of 1s within each group
prop_mat <- sweep(count_mat, 1, group_n, "/")
prop_mat <- as.matrix(prop_mat)

# split group labels back out
group_vars <- do.call(
  rbind,
  strsplit(rownames(prop_mat), split = "\\.")
) |>
  as.data.frame(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

colnames(group_vars) <- c("sector_class", "kingdom")

# clamp proportions to [0,1]
fill_prop <- pmin(pmax(prop_mat, 0), 1)

#==================================================
# TOTAL CHEMICALS IN GROUP (ONES + ZEROS)
#==================================================

total_group_mat <- matrix(
  group_n,
  nrow = nrow(prop_mat),
  ncol = ncol(prop_mat),
  byrow = FALSE,
  dimnames = dimnames(prop_mat)
)

#==================================================
# FLIP / ROTATE FOR DISPLAY
#==================================================

# After transpose:
# - original variables become rows
# - original groups become columns
prop_mat_t        <- t(prop_mat)
fill_prop_t       <- t(fill_prop)
count_mat_t       <- t(count_mat)
total_group_mat_t <- t(total_group_mat)


#==================================================
# PRETTY ROW LABELS (INSERT HERE)
#==================================================

new_row_names <- rownames(prop_mat_t)


# manual overrides (EDIT THESE) Order doesnt matter (matched belwo)
pretty_row_labels <- c(
  "inventory_product"     = "Product Category (Inventory)",
  "inventory_industry"   = "Industrial Category (Inventory)",
  "reported_function_ciexpo"         = "Function (CIExpo-Use)",
  "lp_ciexpo" = "General Use (CIExpo-Use)",
  "predicted_function_ciexpo" = "Predicted Function",
  "consumer_ciexpo" = "Product Category (CIExpo-Use)",  
  "inventory_production" = "Production/Import Volume (Inventory)",
  "inventory_emission" = "Emission Volume (Inventory)",
  "predicted_emission" = "Predicted Emission Volume"
)

idx <- new_row_names %in% names(pretty_row_labels)
new_row_names[idx] <- pretty_row_labels[new_row_names[idx]]

# apply back to ALL matrices used downstream
rownames(prop_mat_t)        <- new_row_names
rownames(fill_prop_t)       <- new_row_names
rownames(count_mat_t)       <- new_row_names
rownames(total_group_mat_t) <- new_row_names


nr <- nrow(prop_mat_t)
nc <- ncol(prop_mat_t)

layout_mat <- matrix(
  0,
  nrow = nr,
  ncol = nc,
  dimnames = list(rownames(prop_mat_t), colnames(prop_mat_t))
)

##Define valid/invalid pies

valid_mat <- matrix(
  TRUE,
  nrow = nrow(prop_mat_t),
  ncol = ncol(prop_mat_t),
  dimnames = dimnames(prop_mat_t)
)

# invalid combinations

valid_mat[
  "Product Category (CIExpo-Use)",
  group_vars$sector_class == "Industrial Only"
] <- FALSE

valid_mat[
  "Predicted Function",
  group_vars$kingdom == "Unstructurable"
] <- FALSE

valid_mat[
  "Product Category (Inventory)",
  group_vars$sector_class == "Industrial Only"
] <- FALSE


valid_mat[
  "Industrial Category (Inventory)",
  group_vars$sector_class %in% c("Consumer Only", "Pharmaceutical Only", "Agricultural Only", "Food Only")
] <- FALSE



fill_prop_t[!valid_mat] <- NA

#==================================================
# FIXED PIE SIZE + BOTTOM ANNOTATION FOR BIN COUNTS
#==================================================

cell_w_mm <- 8
cell_h_mm <- 8

# Fixed pie radius as fraction of smaller cell dimension
pie_r_factor <- 0.45

# Chemical counts to display under each column/bin
# This assumes counts are the same across rows within each column.
# If not, see safety check below.
bin_counts <- total_group_mat_t[1, ]

# Optional safety check: make sure counts are column-level, not row-specific
if (!all(apply(total_group_mat_t, 2, function(z) length(unique(na.omit(z))) <= 1))) {
  warning(
    "total_group_mat_t has different counts across rows within at least one column. ",
    "Using first row for bottom annotation. Check whether this is intended."
  )
}

# Format labels for bottom annotation
bin_count_labels <- formatC(
  bin_counts,
  format = "d",
  big.mark = ","
)

#==================================================
# CATEGORY FOR PIE COLOR (ASSOCIATED WITH ROWS)
#==================================================
# Replace this placeholder with your real row -> category mapping.
# Names must match rownames(prop_mat_t), i.e. the displayed row labels.


#==================================================
# CATEGORY FOR PIE COLOR (ASSOCIATED WITH ROWS)
#==================================================

row_category <- c(
  "Product Category (Inventory)"    = "Traditional",
  "Industrial Category (Inventory)" = "Traditional",
  "Production/Import Volume (Inventory)" = "Traditional",
  "Emission Volume (Inventory)" = "Traditional",
  "Function (CIExpo-Use)"           = "NAM",
  "General Use (CIExpo-Use)"        = "NAM",
  "Predicted Function"              = "NAM",
  "Product Category (CIExpo-Use)"   = "NAM",
  "Predicted Emission Volume"       = "NAM"
)

# make sure order matches displayed rows
row_category <- row_category[rownames(prop_mat_t)]

# safety check
if (any(is.na(row_category))) {
  stop("Some row names in prop_mat_t are missing from row_category.")
}

row_category <- as.character(row_category)

row_cat_levels <- unique(row_category)

if (length(row_cat_levels) > length(ULcolors)) {
  stop("Not enough colors in ULcolors for the number of row categories.")
}

# choose 2 colors explicitly

#==================================================
# TOP ANNOTATION COLORS

make_named_palette <- function(values, palette) {
  levs <- unique(as.character(values))
  
  if (length(levs) > length(palette)) {
    stop("Not enough colors in palette for the number of categories.")
  }
  
  setNames(palette[seq_along(levs)], levs)
}

sector_cols<-c("Industrial Only"= ind_color,"Consumer Only"= consumer_color,"Multiple Inventories"= multiple_color,"Unknown"= unknown_color,"Pharmaceutical Only"=pharma_color,"Agricultural Only" = ag_color,  
"Food Only" = food_color)

#==================================================
# HELPER: DRAW 2-SLICE PIE
#==================================================

draw_pie_cell <- function(x, y, r_mm, prop, fill_col, bg_col = "grey85") {
  
  if (is.na(prop)) return(NULL)
  
  prop <- max(min(prop, 1), 0)
  values <- c(prop, 1 - prop)
  fills  <- c(fill_col, bg_col)
  
  if (sum(values, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  pushViewport(viewport(
    x = x,
    y = y,
    width = unit(2 * r_mm, "mm"),
    height = unit(2 * r_mm, "mm"),
    just = c("center", "center")
  ))
  
  theta <- c(0, cumsum(values) * 2 * pi)
  
  for (k in 1:2) {
    if (values[k] <= 0) next
    
    ang <- seq(theta[k], theta[k + 1], length.out = 100)
    
    xs <- c(0.5, 0.5 + 0.5 * cos(ang), 0.5)
    ys <- c(0.5, 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(ang), 0.5)
    
    grid.polygon(
      x = unit(xs, "npc"),
      y = unit(ys, "npc"),
      gp = gpar(fill = fills[k], col = NA)
    )
  }
  
  popViewport()
}

#==================================================
# HEATMAP
#==================================================


ht <- Heatmap(
  layout_mat,
  name = NULL,
  col = c("0" = "white"),
  show_heatmap_legend = FALSE,
  rect_gp = gpar(col = "grey85", fill = NA),
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  row_names_side = "left",
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  
  # left_annotation = left_ha,
  top_annotation = top_ha,
  bottom_annotation = bottom_ha,
  right_annotation = right_ha,
  
  
  #column_title = "Number of chemicals in group",
  #column_title_side = "bottom",
  #column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8, fontface = "bold"),
  
  width = unit(nc * cell_w_mm, "mm"),
  height = unit(nr * cell_h_mm, "mm"),
  
  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
    
    w_mm <- convertWidth(width, "mm", valueOnly = TRUE)
    h_mm <- convertHeight(height, "mm", valueOnly = TRUE)
    
    # Skip empty or missing cells if needed
    if (is.na(fill_prop_t[i, j])) return(NULL)
    
    # Fixed pie size
    r_mm <- pie_r_factor * min(w_mm, h_mm)
    
    draw_pie_cell(
      x = x,
      y = y,
      r_mm = r_mm,
      prop = fill_prop_t[i, j],
      fill_col = row_cat_cols[row_category[i]],
      bg_col = "grey85"
    )
  }
)
```

```{r}
do_function_plots<- function() {

library(ggplot2)

j<-fingerprints

#merge

tmp<-left_join(inventory_all_descriptors2, j, by=c("cichem_id"="cichem"))

#Decide which categories to keep

#order the levels of function
funccounts<-data.frame(table(tmp$most_common_function_category))
keepfunctions<-funccounts$Var1[which(funccounts$Freq>200)]

keepfunctions<-keepfunctions[keepfunctions!="NA"]
keepfunctions<-keepfunctions[keepfunctions!="NANA"]
keepfunctions<-keepfunctions[!is.na(keepfunctions)]
keepfunctions<-keepfunctions[keepfunctions!="unknown"]
keepfunctions<-keepfunctions[keepfunctions!="Unknown"]

tmp$most_common_function_category2 <- factor(tmp$most_common_function_category, levels = keepfunctions)
                                                                                                                                                                                    
colors<-sample(ULcolors, length(unique(tmp$most_common_function_category2)), replace = TRUE)
tmp2<-tmp[which(tmp$most_common_function_category2!="Unknown"),]
#tmp2<-tmp[which(tmp$most_common_function_category=="Biocide"),]
functiondensity<-ggplot(tmp2, aes(x=densmap_1, y=densmap_2,color=most_common_function_category2)) +
  geom_point(alpha=0.4, size=1, shape=16) +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_color_manual(values=colors) +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank())+
#scale to max and min x and y
  #ylim(min(tmp2$densmap_2),max(tmp2$densmap_2))+xlim(min(tmp2$densmap_1),max(tmp2$densmap_1))
  ylim(-5,20)+xlim(-10,20)+ guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 4, alpha = 1)))



#do the previous plot but facet on most common function
keepfunctions<-funccounts$Var1[which(funccounts$Freq>80)]

keepfunctions<-keepfunctions[keepfunctions!="NA"]
keepfunctions<-keepfunctions[keepfunctions!="NANA"]
keepfunctions<-keepfunctions[!is.na(keepfunctions)]
keepfunctions<-keepfunctions[keepfunctions!="unknown"]
keepfunctions<-keepfunctions[keepfunctions!="Unknown"]

length(keepfunctions)

tmp$most_common_function_category2 <- factor(tmp$most_common_function_category, levels = keepfunctions)

# set.seed(126)
# colors<-sample(ULcolors, length(unique(tmp$most_common_function_category2)), replace = TRUE)
# functionfacet<-ggplot(tmp[tmp$most_common_function_category2 %in% keepfunctions,], aes(x=densmap_1, y=densmap_2,color=most_common_function_category2)) +
#   geom_point(alpha=1,size=0.5, shape=16) +
#   theme_minimal() +
#   scale_color_manual(values=colors) +
#   theme(legend.title = element_blank())+
#   ylim(-5,20)+xlim(-10,20)+
#   facet_wrap(~most_common_function_category2)
# print(functionfacet)


library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

set.seed(126)

colors <- sample(
  ULcolors,
  length(keepfunctions),
  replace = TRUE
)

names(colors) <- keepfunctions

tmp_plot <- tmp %>%
  select(densmap_1, densmap_2, most_common_function_category2) %>%
  mutate(
    most_common_function_category2 = as.character(most_common_function_category2)
  )

tmp_facet <- expand_grid(
  facet_function = as.character(keepfunctions),
  tmp_plot
) %>%
  mutate(
    facet_function = as.character(facet_function),
    has_facet_function = most_common_function_category2 == facet_function
  )

functionfacet <- ggplot() +

  geom_point(
    data = tmp_facet %>% filter(!has_facet_function),
    aes(x = densmap_1, y = densmap_2),
    color = "grey80",
    alpha = 0.3,
    size = 0.5,
    shape = 16
  ) +

  geom_point(
    data = tmp_facet %>% filter(has_facet_function),
    aes(
      x = densmap_1,
      y = densmap_2,
      color = facet_function
    ),
    alpha = 1,
    size = 0.5,
    shape = 16
  ) +
  #no x or y labels
  ylab("")+xlab("")+

  scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank()) +
  coord_cartesian(
    xlim = c(-10, 20),
    ylim = c(-5, 20)
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~facet_function)+theme(legend.position = "none")


return(  list(
    plot1 = functiondensity,
    plot2 = functionfacet
  ))

}
```

```{r}
do_monitoring_plot = function() {
  
  #Monitoring Figure

  load("Data/monitoring_landscape_data_2026-10-12.RData")
  monitoring[is.na(monitoring)]<-0
  
  #mon<-left_join(monitoring,cichemid, by=c("DTXSID"="dtxsid"))

  #move cichem_id to first column
  mon<-mon[,c("cichem_id",colnames(mon)[!colnames(mon) %in% c("cichem_id")])]
  
  mon[is.na(mon)]<-0
  tmp<-mon[3:39]
  k<-colSums(tmp)
  mon<-mon[,!colnames(mon)=="X"]
  
  mon2<-left_join(mon, inventory_all_descriptors2, by=c("cichem_id"="cichem_id"))
  
  namestokeep1<-colnames(mon)[!colnames(mon) %in% c("DTXSID","cichem_id","cicomp")]
  
  mon2<-mon2[which(mon2$cichem %in% inventory_all_descriptors2$cichem),]
  
  
  j<-mon2[,colnames(mon2) %in% c(namestokeep1)]
  mon2$sum <- rowSums(j,na.rm = TRUE)
  j<-j[order(mon2$sector_class,mon2$kingdom,-mon2$sum),]
  mon2<-mon2[order(mon2$sector_class,mon2$kingdom),]
  
  j[] <- lapply(j, function(x) as.character(x) )
  #Traditional Data
  j[j==1]<-"Traditional Monitoring Data"
  j$nontargeted_dust[which(j$nontargeted_dust!=0)]<-"NAM (NTA/Informatic)"
  j$consumer_products[which(j$consumer_products!=0)]<-"NAM (NTA/Informatic)"
  j$nontargeted_drinkingwater[which(j$nontargeted_drinkingwater!=0)]<-"NAM (NTA/Informatic)"
  j$pooled_blood[which(j$pooled_blood!=0)]<-"NAM (NTA/Informatic)"
  j$NTA_biomonitoring_curation[which(j$NTA_biomonitoring_curation!=0)]<-"NAM (NTA/Informatic)"
  #j$BloodExposomeDB[which(j$BloodExposomeDB!=0)]<-"NAM (NTA/Informatic)"
  
  j[j==0]<-"No Data"
  
  
  set1=ULcolors[1:9]
  
  colors1 = structure(c("#D3D3D3",tradcolor, namcolor), names = c("No Data", "Traditional Monitoring Data", "NAM (NTA/Informatic)"))
  colors2 = ULcolors[c(1:7)]
  colors3 = c("#969696","#636363","#252525","#f7f7f7")
  names(colors2) = unique(mon2$sector_class)
  #update colors
  colors2["Industrial Only"] = ind_color
  colors2["Consumer Only"] = consumer_color
  colors2["Multiple Inventories"] = multiple_color
  colors2["Unknown"] = unknown_color
  colors2["Pharmaceutical Only"] = pharma_color
  colors2["Agricultural Only"] = ag_color
  colors2["Food Only"] = food_color
  
  names(colors3) = unique(mon2$kingdom)
  colors3["Organic compounds"] = orgcolor
  colors3["Inorganic compounds"] = inorgcolor
  colors3["Unstructurable"] = unstructcolor
  colors3["Unknown"] = unknown_color
  
  #col_fun = colorRamp2(c(1, 2, 3), c("#D3D3D3",set1[1], set1[2], set1[3]))
  foo = function(x){
    length(which(x!="No Data"))
  }
  
  
  #col_fun = colorRamp2(c(1, 2, 3), c("#D3D3D3",set1[1], set1[2], set1[3]))
  foo = function(x){
    length(which(x!="No Data"))
  }
  
  counts<-sapply(j,foo)
  
  
  j<-j[,!colnames(j) %in% c("unknown","precipitation","other.ecological","other.environmental")]
  
  
  #reorder
  j<-j[,c("wildlife..fish.","wildlife..aquatic.invertebrate.","wildlife..aquatic.vertebrates.mammals.","wildlife..terrestrial.vertebrates.","wildlife..birds.","wildlife..terrestrial.invertebrates.worms.",                          
          "sediment","surface.water", "soil", "wastewater..influent..effluent.", "groundwater","landfill.leachate","sludge","ambient.air",                                
          "vegetation", "raw.agricultural.commodity","food.product", "livestock.meat","drinking.water",
          "indoor.air","personal.air","product","indoor.dust","osha","urine","human.blood..whole.serum.plasma.",
          "human..other.tissues.or.fluids.","skin.wipes","breast.milk","pdp","nontargeted_dust","pooled_blood","NTA_biomonitoring_curation","nontargeted_drinkingwater",                 
          "consumer_products")] 
  counts<-sapply(j,foo)
  collabs<-c(
    "Fish",
    "Aquatic Invertebrates",
    "Aquatic Vertebrates",
    "Terrestrial Vertebrates",
    "Birds",
    "Terrestrial Invertebrates",
    "Sediment",
    "Surface Water",
    "Soil",
    "Wastewater",
    "Groundwater",
    "Landfill Leachate",
    "Sludge",
    "Ambient Air",
    "Vegetation",
    "Raw Agricultural Commodity",
    "Food Product",
    "Livestock/Meat",
    "Drinking Water",
    "Indoor Air",
    "Personal Air",
    "Product",
    "Indoor Dust",
    "Workplace (OSHA)",
    "Human Urine",
    "Human Blood",
    "Human Other Tissues",
    "Skin Wipes",
    "Breast Milk",
    "Crops (PDP)",
    "Indoor Dust",
    "Pooled Human Blood",
    "Human Biomonitoring (Curated NTA)",
    "Drinking Water",
    "Consumer Products (Curated NTA)")

  j_rot<-t(j)
  row.names(j_rot)<-collabs
  
  #do heat map
  library(ComplexHeatmap)
  
  width=12
  height=10 
  tradcol<-"#ef3b2c"
  ylims=c(1, 5000)
  kingdomvec=rev(mon2$kingdom)
  inventoryvec=rev(mon2$sector_class)
  collabs=collabs
  row_splits=c(1,1,1,1,1,1,2,2,2,4)
  name="Data Type"
  row_title="Data"
  column_title="Chemicals"
  
  ha_left <- rowAnnotation(
    text = anno_text(
      collabs,
      rot = 0,
      location = unit(1, "npc"),
      just = "right",
      offset = unit(0, "mm"),
      gp = gpar(fontsize = 9),
      width = max_text_width(collabs)
    )
  )
  
  ## ---- right-side annotation (was top annotation) ----
  
  mediacat<-c(rep("Wildlife",6),rep("Environmental",9),rep("Dietary",4),rep("Indoor",5),rep("Biomonitoring",5),rep("NTA",4))
  mediacat<-factor(mediacat, levels=c("Wildlife","Environmental","Dietary","Indoor","Biomonitoring","NTA"))
  
  ha_right <- rowAnnotation(
    counts = anno_barplot(
      counts,
      ylim = ylims,
      add_numbers = FALSE,
      width = unit(2, "cm"),
      axis_param = list(side = "top")
    ),
    counts2 = anno_text(
      counts,
      rot = 0,
      just = "left",
      location = 0,
      gp = gpar(fontsize = 9),
      width = max_text_width(as.character(counts)) + unit(6, "mm")
    ),
    gap = unit(3, "mm"),
    annotation_name_side = "top"
  )
  
  ha_bottom <- HeatmapAnnotation(

    Inventory = inventoryvec,
    col = list(
      Kingdom = colors3,
      Inventory = colors2
    ),
    which = "column"
  )
  
  k2 <- Heatmap(
    j_rot,
    show_column_names = FALSE,
    show_row_names = FALSE,
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    cluster_columns = FALSE,
    col = colors1,
    use_raster = FALSE,
    name = name,
    #row_title = row_title,
    column_title = column_title,
    row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 7),
    
    ## moved annotations
    left_annotation  = ha_left,
    right_annotation = ha_right,
    bottom_annotation = ha_bottom,
    
    ## splits also swap when you rotate
    #row_split    = row_splits,
    column_split = inventoryvec,
    
    na_col = "white"
  )
  
  
  filename<-"Output/media_landscape.png"

  png(filename, width = 10, height = 9, units="in", res = 300)
  
  draw(
    k2,
    heatmap_legend_side = "bottom",
    annotation_legend_side = "bottom",
    merge_legends = TRUE
  )
  dev.off()
  return(filename)
  
#Save chemicals that have NTA biomonitoring

#remove if it has been previously measured
```

```{r}
  mon2<-left_join(mon, inventory_all_descriptors2, by=c("cichem_id"="cichem_id"))
  
  namestokeep1<-colnames(mon)[!colnames(mon) %in% c("DTXSID","cichem_id","cicomp")]
  
  mon2<-mon2[which(mon2$cichem %in% inventory_all_descriptors2$cichem),] #we want to limit to chemicals that are in the collection
  
  j<-mon2[,colnames(mon2) %in% c(namestokeep1)]
  mon2$sum <- rowSums(j,na.rm = TRUE)
  j<-j[order(mon2$sector_class,mon2$kingdom,-mon2$sum),]
  mon2<-mon2[order(mon2$sector_class,mon2$kingdom),]
  
  j[] <- lapply(j, function(x) as.character(x) )
  #Traditional Data
  j[j==1]<-"Traditional Monitoring Data"
  j$nontargeted_dust[which(j$nontargeted_dust!=0)]<-"NAM (NTA/Informatic)"
  j$consumer_products[which(j$consumer_products!=0)]<-"NAM (NTA/Informatic)"
  j$nontargeted_drinkingwater[which(j$nontargeted_drinkingwater!=0)]<-"NAM (NTA/Informatic)"
  j$pooled_blood[which(j$pooled_blood!=0)]<-"NAM (NTA/Informatic)"
  j$NTA_biomonitoring_curation[which(j$NTA_biomonitoring_curation!=0)]<-"NAM (NTA/Informatic)"
  #j$BloodExposomeDB[which(j$BloodExposomeDB!=0)]<-"NAM (NTA/Informatic)"
  
  j[j==0]<-"No Data"
  
  paste0("Number of collection chemicals data: ", length(j$consumer_products))
  
   #Supplemental Table 2
  #count the number of cells in each ROW that are NOT equal to "No Data"
  NAM <- rowSums(j == "NAM (NTA/Informatic)" & !is.na(j))
  Trad <- rowSums(j == "Traditional Monitoring Data" & !is.na(j))
  
  NAM<-ifelse(NAM>0,1,0)
  Trad<-ifelse(Trad>0,1,0)
  NAM_only<-ifelse(NAM==1 & Trad==0,1,0)
  #Combine with sector_class and sector 
  mon2$NAM<-NAM
  mon2$Trad<-Trad
  mon2$NAM_only<-NAM_only

 mon3<-left_join(mon2,rocks_sector_table) 
 k0<-c("All Chemicals",length(which(mon3$Trad==1)),   length(which(mon3$NAM==1)),length(which(mon3$NAM_only==1))) 
 k1<-c("Industrial",length(which(mon3$industrial==1 & mon3$Trad==1)), length(which(mon3$industrial==1 & mon3$NAM==1)), length(which(mon3$industrial==1 & mon3$NAM_only==1)))
 k2<-c("Food",length(which(mon3$food==1)), length(which(mon3$food==1 & mon3$NAM==1)), length(which(mon3$food==1 & mon3$NAM_only==1)))
 k3<-c("Consumer",length(which(mon3$consumer==1)), length(which(mon3$consumer==1 & mon3$NAM==1)), length(which(mon3$consumer==1 & mon3$NAM_only==1)))
 k4<-c("Pharmaceutical",length(which(mon3$pharmaceutical==1)), length(which(mon3$pharmaceutical==1 & mon3$NAM_only==1)), length(which(mon3$pharmaceutical==1 & mon3$NAM_only==1)))
 k5<-c("Agricultural",length(which(mon3$agricultural==1)), length(which(mon3$agricultural==1 & mon3$NAM==1)), length(which(mon3$agricultural==1 & mon3$NAM_only==1)))
 
 k6<-data.frame(table(mon3$sector_class[which(mon3$Trad==1)]))
 colnames(k6)<-c("Sector_or_Class","Count with Traditional Monitoring Data")
 k7<-data.frame(table(mon3$sector_class[which(mon3$NAM==1)]))
 colnames(k7)<-c("Sector_or_Class","Count with NAM (NTA/Informatic) Data")
 k8<-data.frame(table(mon3$sector_class[which(mon3$NAM_only==1)]))
 colnames(k8)<-c("Sector_or_Class","Count with Only NAM Data")
 
 k9<-left_join(k6,k7,by=c("Sector_or_Class"="Sector_or_Class")) 
 k9<-left_join(k9,k8,by=c("Sector_or_Class"="Sector_or_Class"))
 
 k<-data.frame(rbind(k0,k1,k2,k3,k4,k5))
 colnames(k)<-c("Sector_or_Class","Count with Traditional Monitoring Data","Count with NAM (NTA/Informatic) Data","Count with Only NAM Data")

 k$Sector_or_Class<-as.character(k$Sector_or_Class)
 k9$Sector_or_Class<-as.character(k9$Sector_or_Class)
 
 SupplementalTable2<-rbind(k,k9)

 SupplementalTable2$Sector_or_Class[SupplementalTable2$Sector_or_Class=="industrial"]<-"Industrial"
 SupplementalTable2$Sector_or_Class[SupplementalTable2$Sector_or_Class=="consumer"]<-"Consumer"
 SupplementalTable2$Sector_or_Class[SupplementalTable2$Sector_or_Class=="agricultural"]<-"Agricultural"

 SupplementalTable2<-SupplementalTable2[(!SupplementalTable2$Sector_or_Class=="Unknown"),]

 print(SupplementalTable2)  
 write.csv(SupplementalTable2,"Output/SupplementalTable5.csv",row.names = FALSE)
  
 #How many of the NTA consumer product and biomonitoring chemicals had no traditional monitoring data

 paste0("Number of NTA consumer product chemicals with no traditional monitoring data: ", length(which(mon3$consumer_products==1 & mon3$Trad==0)))
 paste0("Number of NTA biomonitoring chemicals with no traditional monitoring data: ", length(which(mon3$NTA_biomonitoring_curation==1 &  mon3$Trad==0)))
```

```{r}
do_method_plot = function() {
#Look at structure and sector space of the levels of chemicals detected in humans

load("Data/monitoring_landscape_data_2026-10-12.RData")
load("Data/blood_db_CIIW_curated.RData")
#load the most recent rocks_sector_table.RData file
#find the most recent file in the directory
files<-list.files("Data/categories", pattern = "rocks_sector_table.*\\.RData$", full.names = TRUE)
file <- files[order(file.info(files)$mtime, decreasing = TRUE)][1]  # Get the most recent 
load(file)


j<-left_join(inventory_all_descriptors2, fingerprints, by=c("cichem_id"="cichem"))
j<-left_join(j, rocks_sector_table[,c("cichem_id","pharmaceutical","agricultural","food","consumer","industrial")], by=c("cichem_id"="cichem_id"))
j<-left_join(j, monitoring, by=c("cichem_id"="cichem_id"))
j<-left_join(j, BloodExposomeDB, by=c("cichem_id"="cichem_id"))

j[is.na(j)]<-0


#Make flags for trad, NTA, and BloodExposomeDB
cols <- c(
  "human.blood..whole.serum.plasma.",
  "human..other.tissues.or.fluids.",
  "urine",
  "skin.wipes",
  "breast.milk"
)

j$trad_flag <- apply(j[, cols], 1, max, na.rm = TRUE)

cols <- c(
  "NTA_biomonitoring_curation",
  "pooled_blood"
)
j$nta_flag<-apply(j[, cols], 1, max, na.rm = TRUE)

j2<-j[,c("cichem_id","densmap_1","densmap_2","trad_flag","nta_flag","BloodExposomeDB","pharmaceutical","industrial","food","agricultural","consumer","inventory_environmental","inventory_biomonitoring")]

#Make a Bar Chart of the number of chemicals with traditional monitoring, NTA, BloodExposomeDB, by sector

j2_long <- j2 %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c("pharmaceutical","industrial","food","agricultural","consumer","inventory_environmental","inventory_biomonitoring"),
    names_to = "sector_class",
    values_to = "sector_flag"
  ) %>%
  filter(sector_flag == 1)


toplot <- j2_long %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c("trad_flag", "nta_flag", "BloodExposomeDB"),
    names_to = "method",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  filter(value == 1) %>%
  group_by(method, sector_class) %>%
  summarise(
    count = n_distinct(cichem_id),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

all_chems <- j2_long %>%
  group_by(sector_class) %>%
  summarise(
    count = n_distinct(cichem_id),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(method = "All Chemicals")

toplot <- bind_rows(toplot, all_chems)

# Add % coverage relative to all chemicals in each sector
toplot_annot <- toplot %>%
  group_by(sector_class) %>%
  mutate(
    all_count = count[method == "All Chemicals"][1],
    pct_coverage = 100 * count / all_count,
    label = if_else(
      method == "All Chemicals",
      "   ",
      paste0(round(pct_coverage, 1), "%")
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

toplot_annot$sector_class[toplot_annot$sector_class=="inventory_biomonitoring"]<-"biomonitoring"
toplot_annot$sector_class[toplot_annot$sector_class=="inventory_environmental"]<-"environmental"

#capitalize all
toplot_annot$sector_class<-capitalize_first(toplot_annot$sector_class)


sector_order <- c(
  "Pharmaceutical",
  "Industrial",
  "Food",
  "Agricultural",
  "Consumer",
  "Environmental",
  "Biomonitoring"
)

toplot_annot <- toplot_annot %>%
  mutate(
    sector_class = factor(sector_class, levels = sector_order)
  )

pd <- position_dodge(width = 0.9)

barplot <- ggplot(toplot_annot, aes(x = sector_class, y = count, fill = method)) +
geom_bar(
  stat = "identity",
  position = pd,
  width = 0.7
) +
  geom_text(
    data = toplot_annot,
    aes(label = label),
    position = pd,
    vjust = -0.3,
    size = 3
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Number of Chemicals Detected in Humans by Method and Sector Class",
    x = "Sector Class",
    y = "Number of Chemicals"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "trad_flag" = tradcolor,
      "nta_flag" = namcolor,
      "BloodExposomeDB" = bloodexcolor,
      "All Chemicals" = "gray"
    ),
labels = c(
   "trad_flag" = "Targeted Biomonitoring",
   "nta_flag" = "NTA",
   "BloodExposomeDB" = "Blood Exposome DB",
   "All Chemicals" = "All Chemicals"
)
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    trans = "log10"
  )+ theme(legend.title = element_blank())

#Now do a densemap plot of the chemicals detected in humans by method

j3<-j[,c("cichem_id","densmap_1","densmap_2","trad_flag","nta_flag","BloodExposomeDB","inventory_biomonitoring")]

#plot Blood exposome points
p1<-ggplot(j3, aes(x=densmap_1, y=densmap_2)) +
  geom_point(data=j3[which(j3$inventory_biomonitoring==0),], aes(color="gray"),alpha=0.1, size=0.6, shape=16)+
  geom_point(data=j3[which(j3$BloodExposomeDB==1),], aes(color="Blood Exposome DB"),alpha=0.3, size=0.6, shape=16) +
  geom_point(data=j3[which(j3$nta_flag==1),], aes(color="NTA"), alpha=0.7, size=0.9, shape=16) +
  geom_point(data=j3[which(j3$trad_flag==1),], aes(color="Targeted Biomonitoring"), alpha=0.7, size=1, shape=16) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title="Structure Space of Chemicals Detected in Humans", x=" ", y=" ") +
  scale_color_manual(values=c("Targeted Biomonitoring"=tradcolor, "NTA"=namcolor, "Blood Exposome DB"=bloodexcolor)) +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank()) + 
  ylim(-5,20)+xlim(-10,20)+ guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 4, alpha = 1)))

list<-list(barplot, p1)

}
```

```{r}
    alpha = 0.9,
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.25
  ) +

  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Predicted exposure",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Distribution across chemicals of SEEM3.1 Median Intakes (mg/kg-BW/day)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8)
  )

    geom_boxplot() +

     ylim = c(1e-12, 1e6)
   )

seemuncinset<-ggplot(

geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +

  xlab("") +

  )

library(patchwork)
```
